# CoCache

> Two-level distributed coherent cache for Java/Kotlin on Spring Boot 4: bounded local Caffeine (L2) in front of shared Redis (L1) in front of a data source, with invalidation broadcast over Redis Pub/Sub and bounded staleness. Maven group `me.ahoo.cocache`; JDK 17+.

Declare a cache as an interface (`@CoCache interface UserCache : Cache<String, User>`), register it with `@EnableCoCache(caches = [...])`, and provide a `CacheSource<K, V>` bean that loads on a miss (`null` = negative entry). Write pattern: update the data source first, then `evict(key)`.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/): the problem, guarantees, and when not to use CoCache
- [Quick Start](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/quick-start): dependency, cache interface, source, usage
- [Configuration](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/configuration): `@CoCache`/`@CaffeineCache`, `cocache.*` properties, per-cache component beans, Redis codecs
- [JoinCache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/join-cache): composing two caches
- [Spring Cache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/spring-cache): `@Cacheable` through `CoCacheManager`
- [Operations](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/operations): actuator endpoints, Redis failure policy, negative-cache sentinel, troubleshooting
- [Changelog](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/changelog): releases and 4.x → 5.0 migration table

## Design

- [Architecture](https://cocache.ahoo.me/architecture/): goals, modules, data model, proxy wiring
- [Consistency](https://cocache.ahoo.me/architecture/consistency): read/write paths, invalidation stamps, eviction channel, guarantees and known windows
- [Extending CoCache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/architecture/extending): SPI contracts and the `cocache-test` TCK
- [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/CoCache/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): normative design and invariants (Chinese)
